name: CPS-UChicago Program
org: University of Chicago with Chicago Public Schools
what_you_do: Advanced CPS juniors and seniors take one college class each quarter at the University of Chicago. They sit in class with UChicago students. The classes go on the CPS transcript.
who_can_apply: You must have been in CPS this year and last year. You will be a junior or senior. You have a strong record in the hardest courses you can take. You are ready for college work.
pay_detail: $800 tuition plus $75 lifetime transcript fee (books not included) if household income is over $60,000. $0 tuition, with books and fees covered, if under $60,000.
duration: Autumn, Winter and Spring Quarters; one course per quarter
deadline_text: For 2026-27 the application opened June 8, 2026 and closed July 15, 2026. 2027-28 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out an online application. It has short essays, a graded work sample, a teacher recommendation and transcripts. It also has an online interview in mid-August. For the $0 tuition option, you need financial aid papers.
notes: UChicago classes do not follow the CPS calendar, so you attend even when your high school is on break. Many students stop after Winter Quarter.
